title: The Copper Bridge
author: Coral Villalobos
blurb: Freya Pemberton, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
